env.cpu_marketing_name_measured_on_dev_machi: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1340P (12 cores/16 threads)

q4_1a_matching.definition: strength S(F)=Var(F(n))/Var(n) on a flat zero-mean white-noise field; bilateral sigma_s chosen so S matches Kuwahara

q4_1b_performance.ssim_impl: Gaussian 11x11 sigma 1.5, K1=.01 K2=.03, valid region (common.py; equals skimage within 1e-14)

q4_2b_blockiness.tau_rule: tau = (Immerkaer sigma_hat)^2 on noisy input; on the clean input tau uses the noisy estimate 14.99^2

bilateral_(2r+1)^2.note: per neighbour: sub, square, scale by -1/(2 sr^2), exp, ws*wr, w*I, 2 accumulations; ws precomputed

classical_kuwahara_direct.note: direct window sums: m^2-1 adds for sum, m^2 mult + m^2-1 adds for sum of squares, then mean, mean^2, variance, x4 windows

classical_kuwahara_integral.note: with integral images of I and I^2 (2 adds + 1 mult per pixel to build): 4 corner lookups = 3 adds per box sum, independent of N

soft_kuwahara_direct.note: classical + 4 subs (v-vmin), 4 scalings by 1/tau, 4 exps, 4 w*mean, 6 adds, 1 division
